Vt.bar_b_note: An appealing, well-built stylised elder with a clear face, eyes and a green/brown palette that suits the Meadows, but the flat grey stage with no sky, fog or time-of-day grade carries none of the Valheim-class atmosphere.

Eo.bar_b_note: The deep blue-grey translucent panel matches the UI direction, but the murky, flat rainy backdrop and the missing teal/gold accents and controller-first prompt chips sink the shipping-game finish.

Lf.bar_b_note: Same strong character read as a Palworld-class villager, sunk by the neutral grey stage: there is no world light, sky or atmosphere to compare.

Kg.bar_b_note: The gold Voltarach reads, but flat magenta ground rings and chevrons as telegraphs, a near-invisible player creature, a heavy HUD, a brown murk with no purple storm sky or lightning, and (B) camera-in-foliage frames are far from Palworld's boss-fight clarity.

Bs.bar_b_note: The standing Tanglevolt is near the owner bar, but broken faint poses (A floating with a white-washed material, B tipped onto its nose) and a bare stage keep it short of shipping finish.

Gc.bar_b_note: A warm, cozy smith silhouette that fits the village palette, sunk by soft low-resolution face textures with tiny slit eyes and a black void stage with no light or atmosphere.

top_changes.change: Kg: replace the flat magenta telegraph rings and chevrons with real-object storm effects (white-violet lightning, sparks, ground cracks with an impact), keep the camera out of trunks and foliage, frame both the Voltarach and the player creature, and add the fixed purple storm sky with rim light so the fighters separate from the brown ground

Eo: ship side A's large-type craft layout, then turn Craft/Leave into controller-first teal prompt chips (A / B glyphs) with gold for progression, and widen the recipe list so subtitles never truncate

Bs: author grounded hit-react and faint animations (no floating body in faint mid, no vertical nose-down faint end, distinct hit react) and keep the fur and lightning-vein material consistent across all poses
